sentences.text:
Author: D.Dash
Bench: D.Dash
 Ablapl No.15200 Of 2020
 03. 26.02.2021
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (virtual/physical) mode.

The petitioner having been implicated in connection with  Malgodown P.S. Case No.221 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. Case  No.1345 of 2020 running for alleged commission of offence under sections 420/272/273/34, I.P.C. and section 51/52/56/59/63 & 57 o  Food Safety and Standard Act and section 14 of the Prevention of  Food Adulteration Act pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C.
 (City), Cuttack, has filed this application for grant of anticipa  Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned cou  for the State.

Considering the submissions and on going through the cas  dairy more importantly the Food Analysis report relating to Chill  Powder, Haldi Powder and the chemical, i.e., colouring agent of t  Deputy Director-cum-Food Analysts, Government of Odisha
, this  Court finds that is not a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail  petitioner.

However, it is observed that in the event the petitio  surrenders before the court in seisin of the aforesaid case and m  for his release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own   without being prejudiced by this order and disposed of early in  accordance with law.
The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.

.........................
 D.Dash, J.
H ABLAPL/15200/2020 on 26 February, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147382804/
